FossilOrigin-Name: b8a8132e7148a7c90ca1352f20ab71d97b0bc4b0
pr_title: Add URI filename support with overflow-safe parsing
pr_description:
Introduce URI filenames for database opens and ATTACH, including percent decoding and query options for VFS selection and open flags. Use full string lengths and 64-bit parser indexes and allocation arithmetic, rejecting requests beyond the allocator's supported size before converting to int.

Validation: library and test fixture build successfully; all 31 existing URI tests pass with no memory leaks; workspace validation passes.
